clue.text: Scientific study exposed trope in collection of writings

explanation.walkthrough: 'Exposed' looks like it means revealed, but here it means stripped of its outer letters; the middle of the trope then slips into ANTH-OLOGY.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthropology is the academic discipline examining human societies, cultures and their development, so it counts as a scientific study.

clue.text: Mix up the order of a couple of farm animals

explanation.definitionFit: An anagram is a word formed by rearranging letters, so it is loosely what you get when you jumble the sequence of a word.

clue.text: Traditional tales of feet?
